Mark Drakeford (born 19 September 1954) is a Welsh politician who has served as Cabinet Secretary for Finance since September 2024, having previously held the position from 2016 to 2018. He previously served as First Minister of Wales and Leader of Welsh Labour from 2018 to 2024, and as Cabinet Secretary for Health and Social Care from 2013 to 2016, [ c ] and on an interim basis in 2024. He served as the Member of the Senedd (MS) for Cardiff West in 2011 until 2026, when he stood down. [ 2 ] He is considered to be on the soft left of Labour.
